svg.title: Performance and estimated inference cost
svg.desc: 30 configurations. Horizontal axis: estimated mean US dollars per episode on a logarithmic scale. Vertical axis: normalized Max score, from 20 to 90 percent. Higher and farther left is better. The dashed line is the frontier across all 30 configurations. Each point has a title with its configuration and values.
svg.text: Estimated cost per episode (USD · log scale)
